newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile blue chips tumble to lowest level this year.
newsitem.headline: Chile blue chips tumble to lowest level this year.

text.p: Chilean blue chip stocks skidded 1.32 percent Thursday to close at their lowest point this year on a wave of selling by foreign investors, especially of electricity stocks, said traders.

The bolsa is seen stabilizing at Friday's opening, although the underlying mood will remain weak as the result of the uncertainty of the impact of this year's drought on power companies' profits, they said.
The 40-share IPSA ended down 1.32 percent at 90.39 points. The general IPSA index shed 0.5 percent to 5,010.57 points.
Thursday's drop was the second time the bolsa has hit a year-low point this week. On Monday, blue chip stocks slid to 91.41 points.
Turnover rose to 14.4 billion pesos with volume boosted by stock offerings including the sale of a stake in shipping company Vapores.
Traders reported heavy selling by foreign investors of electricity stocks which account for a 40 percent weighting in the IPSA index.
"Today's fall was not a surprise as the light rises in the last two days proved to be short-lived," said one trader.
"Nothing has changed investors' negative to Chile," he said.
Losers included power utility Edelnor, off 7.27 percent at 255 pesos and generator Colbun which fell 5.88 percent 32 pesos.
